t: Kedat mah laasot betzitzit shennipsequ betallitot yeshanim
s: Kedat mah laasot betzitzit shennipsequ betallitot yeshanim ubo h' seipim: tzitzit — tashmishe mitzva hen, kelomar sheen beatzman shum qedushsha raq shemmishtammeshin bahen leshem mitzva, lepikak achar shennipsequ min hattallit — yakol lezorqan apillu laashpa. Abal kol zeman shehen qebuin battallit — asur lehishtammesh bahen shum tashmish shel chol, kegon liqshor bahem shum dabar vekayyotze bazeh, mishshum bizzuy mitzva. Veyesh omerim deap leachar shennipsequ en linhog bahem minhag bizzayon lezorqan baashpa o lekol maqom megunneh (abal yakol lezorqan shello bemaqom megunneh), veen tzarik legonzan, lepi sheen bahem qedushsha. Veap al pi shehalaka kassebara harishona, mikkol maqom hammachamir umedaqdeq bemitzvot — tabo alayv beraka. Veyesh baale hannepesh shemmachamirin legonzan o lehannichan tok seper echad lesiman, hoil venaasa bahem mitzva achat — yaasu bahen mitzva acheret:
Tallitot shel mitzva shebbalu — adam bodel et atzmo mehen, veeno muttar leqanneach et atzmo bahen, velo lehishtammesh bahen shum tashmish megunneh, ella zoreqan vehen kalin mealehen:

Muttar likkanes betallit metzuyyetzet lebet hakkisse, lepi sheen zeh bizzuy lammitzva kol kak. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bebeged sheasuy lemalbush veeno meyuchad lehitpallel bo, abal betallitot shel mitzva shellanu sheenan meyuchadim raq lehitpallel bahen — en nakon sheyyikkanes bahem lebet hakkisse. Veken haholek lippanot beyom hakkippurim — tzarik lipshot et haqqitel, kevan sheeno meyuchad raq lehitpallel:
Abal muttar lishon apillu betallitot shel mitzva,lepi sheen zeh genay kol kak. Veken muttar littenam lekobes apillu hu nokri:
Yesh lizzaher shello yihyu tzitziyyotayv nigrarim al gabbe qarqa, mishshum bizzuy mitzva:
